security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG helper for Zicfiss instructions checks only CSR[menvcfg].SSE but neglects CSR[senvcfg].SSE for U-mode and CSR[henvcfg].SSE for VS/VU-mode, allowing shadow-stack operations at privilege levels where the controlling envcfg has SSE=0
security_spec.summary: Incomplete multi-level SSE enable-check in Zicfiss instruction emulation bypasses supervisor's ability to disable shadow stack for U-mode or virtualized guests
